mainText: Good morning. It's Wednesday, November 25th, and markets are sharply lower this morning. S and P 500 futures are down about one and a half percent, the Dow is down about three quarters of a percent, and the Nasdaq is down about two and four tenths percent. The selloff in A I stocks is deepening, and there are reports of new U S tariffs on sixteen trading partners. October P C E and third quarter G D P come out at eight thirty this morning. The ten year Treasury yield is about 4.86 percent, down about four basis points from Tuesday. Biggest movers: Ambarella down thirty six percent on weak results and guidance, Nvidia down about five percent, Dell down six percent, Workday down about nine percent, and Dollar Tree up eleven percent. Markets are closed tomorrow for Thanksgiving.
